title: OPM revamps online pay tables, spearheads AI adoption across federal workforce
summary: The agency's CIO Adam Starr described the pay table refresh as part of a broader plan to “make every part of the federal experience tech-first."

title: Trump quietly hired political appointees under a new job classification, good government group reports
summary: While Schedule G is not officially set up in regulation, the Office of Personnel Management emphasized that the position category for political appointees was established by executive order and that the agency issued implementing guidance.

title: Cost-of-living adjustments for federal retirees to increase next year
summary: Former federal workers are set to receive between 2.6% and 3.6% more from their retirement annuity next year, according to new numbers from the Social Security Administration.

title: ICE resists automatic activation of body cameras despite oversight concerns
summary: Federal investigators found gaps in guidance for immigration officers’ use of body-worn cameras, raising concerns about whether the agencies can ensure the devices are used as required.

title: A judge just put USDA’s employee relocation plans on ice
summary: The order blocks the department from moving about 2,600 employees or closing affected offices while a legal challenge to its reorganization proceeds.

title: Disability accommodations at Labor get extra scrutiny with annual reviews
summary: The department plans to review existing accommodations for disabilities and pregnancy-related conditions, with employees potentially asked to provide updated medical documentation.

title: Fraud-prevention work stalled at USDA amid staffing cuts and funding disputes
summary: Federal officials have identified ways to curb theft of SNAP benefits, but staffing losses, funding decisions and congressional inaction have slowed efforts to protect recipients.

title: Labor has mostly stopped checking whether federal contractors are following disability rules
summary: A watchdog found that the Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs has no plans to restart routine audits, leaving less oversight of protections for workers with disabilities.

title: USDA reshapes its food assistance agency, but employee relocations remain on hold
summary: The Food and Nutrition Service is moving ahead with its reorganization, but plans to relocate most of its employees remain on hold for now.

title: The Pentagon gave $350 million in contracts to a firm closely tied to a senior Defense Department official
summary: The contracts raise questions about whether personal and professional ties to senior defense officials gave the firm an advantage in securing Pentagon business.

title: 8 midterm races for federal employees to watch
summary: Several high-profile races, including Senate elections in Maine, Georgia and Texas, could impact civil servants.

title: HHS scraps disability accommodations over missing paperwork. Employees say they have receipts
summary: A union leader for CDC headquarters employees said the Health and Human Services Department closing out these accommodation requests was “a deliberate choice to clear the backlog."

title: Watchdog to examine summertime hack of DHS information network, other incidents
summary: The Government Accountability Office is expected to flag that the Homeland Security Department delayed in notifying Congress of the incidents, according to a person familiar with the review.

title: Bureau of Prisons re-terminates union contracts despite court order
summary: Attorneys for the Trump administration said there is nothing in U.S. District Judge Vernon Oliver’s preliminary injunction preventing BOP from canceling its collective bargaining agreements a second time.

title: VA rolls out CLEAR login option and in-person identity verification pilot
summary: The new offering will allow participating veterans to use facial recognition to access their VA.gov accounts.

title: Some former federal employees are still struggling to find the right fit
summary: Workforce officials and lawmakers say some of the employees pushed out of government last year are still struggling to find work that matches their skills.

title: Don’t let 5% become your TSP retirement strategy
summary: Getting the full agency match is a good baseline, but if retirement is around the corner there’s more to consider before deciding what to do with the rest of your paycheck.

title: Union demands federal prison leaders be held in contempt after agency ‘openly defies’ court order
summary: The U.S. Bureau of Prisons director reportedly said in a meeting shortly before an injunction required him to restore the agency’s union contracts, “I don’t take directives from the court. I take my orders from the president.”

title: Social Security ends flexible work schedules, teeing up clash with union
summary: The agency’s top HR official says these changes are necessary to “deliver the service the public expects.” A union argues SSA violated its labor contract making this decision on its own.

title: Using holiday lights to inform hurricane recovery? Award honors ‘seemingly odd’ federally funded research that brings about groundbreaking discoveries
summary: The Trump administration has sought to upend federal support for scientific research, including through budget cuts and granting political appointees more control over the grantmaking process.

title: What happens when the State Department loses its institutional memory?
summary: COMMENTARY | With dozens of ambassadorial posts still vacant, the staffing of U.S. embassies is raising questions about the role of career diplomats and the experience needed to carry out American policy overseas.

title: Bureau of Prisons is the latest agency ordered to reinstate union rights
summary: As of Tuesday, at least one correctional facility has refused to recognize its union local, in apparent contravention of a preliminary injunction issued last week.

title: GSA still has problems with location data for federal properties, watchdog finds
summary: The agency has agreed to five recommendations aimed at improving the accuracy and management of the information.
